info.name: BarSupplies Midnight Blue V2.2
info.description: BarSupplies Midnight Blue Dark Mode transforms BarSupplies.com into a sleek, modern browsing experience with deep midnight-navy backgrounds, vibrant electric-blue accents, crisp white typography, and subtle blue-gray borders. Designed to reduce eye strain while preserving product imagery, readability, and a polished, premium aesthetic.
